Handcrafted under rigid North American manufacturing standards, its integration into your treatment workflow enhances the performance of topical formulas while supporting long-term practitioner positioning during intensive protocols.
settings.custom_description: The 66001 Heat pad is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Clinical Spa Therapists, and Lash Technicians. Its precision-engineered warming surface targets postural strain and lower-back tension during extended treatment sessions, enabling sharper focus on technical precision and enhanced client comfort. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, post-procedure recovery, or advanced skin rejuvenation, this treatment equipment adapts to your workflow need with friction-free adjustment and instant-response calibration.
settings.subtitle: Multi-Zone Thermal Optimization for High-End Salons
settings.secondary_description: Hygiene and material preservation are central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the flexible structure and uniform heat conductivity of the 66001 Heat pad, routine surface sanitation should be executed with a professional disinfectant spray formulated for non-porous salon environments after every client encounter. The protective outer surface exhibits high chemical resistance properties, ensuring an unblemished, sanitized condition across high-volume operational years. Consistent care prevents localized degradation, preserves internal core insulation, and maximizes total operational reliability.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Spread the heating pad flat over the primary upholstery of your treatment bed, ensuring it is entirely free of folds, wrinkles, or bunched edges before covering it with a protective linen or vinyl sheet.
Plug the heavy-duty power connector into a certified wall outlet and toggle the main power switch to initiate internal circuit calibration.
Use the adjustment dial to calibrate the system to the requested setting, choosing an optimal operational baseline between 37°C and 43°C (100°F and 110°F).
Activate the system approximately 10 minutes prior to client booking to allow the core elements to reach total thermal saturation and uniform surface output.
Power down the unit immediately following the conclusion of daily shifts, clearing the surface of linens to facilitate rapid cooling and standard sanitation.
Do not immerse the electrical components or controller in liquid; ensure the unit is protected by an impervious barrier sheet during wet body treatments or hydro-exfoliation.
Never operate the heating pad when bunched or folded, as this can compress internal wiring, distort the thermal sensors, and void the factory warranty.
Any internal structural modifications, repairs, or splicing performed by uncertified personnel instantly invalidates all international safety certifications and factory guarantees.

settings.question: What is the precise temperature adjustment range?
settings.answer: The 66001 Heat Pad offers two adjustable intensity levels maintaining temperatures between 100°F and 110°F (37°C to 43°C).

settings.question: What are the exact product dimensions and weight?
settings.answer: The pad measures 72" L x 30" W (183 cm x 76.2 cm) and weighs 3.5 lbs (1.6 kg).

settings.question: Does it include a protective cover?
settings.answer: Yes, it comes complete with a removable and washable protective cover.

settings.question: What are the daily maintenance requirements for this equipment?
settings.answer: Sanitize the surface cover after each client with a non-porous salon disinfectant spray, and wash the outer protective cover periodically.

settings.question: Can it be safely utilized during intense body wraps?
settings.answer: Yes, provided an impervious moisture barrier sheet protects the pad and controller from direct liquid contact.

settings.answer: The Heat Pad is backed by a 1-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty covering parts and labor.
